# パラメータ

# 計算の設定
mixing = 0.25
tol = 1.0e-10
maxiter = 10000

# 初期電子密度

amplitude = 0.1
alternating = Float64[(-1)^site for site in 1:L]
alternating[L÷2+1:end] .*= -1

up0 = N_up / L .+ amplitude .* alternating
down0 = N_down / L .- amplitude .* alternating
